Retatrutide hits a third hormone receptor that tirzepatide and semaglutide never touch, and that's the whole reason it's outperforming both of them.

GLP-1 slows your stomach and cuts your appetite, and GIP helps your body use the nutrients from your food better. Tirzepatide https://t.co/lZba9lhFt7
drafts.text: Retatrutide is a triple agonist for GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors. Glucagon receptor agonism may increase energy expenditure, contributing to its observed efficacy in Phase 2 trials.
